reviews.text: It is an okay cushion foundation. It goes on beautifully and is medium-full coverage but it doesnt last very long. It creases almost immediately (see photo of the smile lines). When I blow my nose, it wipes the makeup off my nose. This is after setting powering and setting spray as well. It does give a very dewy finish.
reviews.zh: 呢個氣墊粉底一般。上妝效果好靚，遮瑕屬中至高，但係好快就甩妝。幾乎即刻就卡紋（可以參考笑紋嗰張相）。我擤鼻涕嘅時候，粉就會直接甩晒。呢個已經係上咗碎粉同定妝噴霧之後嘅效果。妝效的確幾水光。

reviews.text: I’m already on my third one! One of my favorite mesh cushions that I reach all year round. Has a medium to high coverage, a healthy glow/sheen finish, and a little goes a long way. I would say there is a bit of a transfer but if nothing a setting spray or powder can’t fix. I get compliments on my skin whenever I use this!
reviews.zh: 已經係第三個啦！其中一款我最鍾意嘅網紗氣墊，成日都會攞嚟用。遮瑕度中至高，妝效係健康光澤／微微亮澤感，而且少量就夠用。我會話有少少甩色，不過用定妝噴霧或者碎粉就可以解決。每次用都有人讚我皮膚狀態好！

reviews.text:
I've always used matte cushions because dewy ones never had enough coverage and didn't last long enough so I didn't have huge hopes for this but it actually blew me away. Not only is this cushion super long lasting (lasts all day on my dry skin) but just one tap of the cushion on the mesh provides perfect coverage. You really don't need a lot of the product at all for your base so it feels like it's going to last a long time.
It doesn't accentuate dry patches and it's super moisturising. 
The dewiness this gives on my skin is more like a glass glow finish which is exactly what I was looking for. Even after a laborious 12 hour shift barely any oil came through and the original dewy finish was still present.
I highly highly recommend this cushion to my fellow dry skin folks. If you struggle with redness I recommend getting the #1.5 shade because it neutralises it beautifully.
reviews.zh:
我一直都用霧面氣墊，因為水光嗰啲遮瑕度永遠唔夠，又唔夠持久，所以本來對呢個冇乜期望，點知竟然令我刮目相睇。呢個氣墊唔單止超級持久（喺我嘅乾性肌上面撐到全日），只需要用粉撲輕輕印一下個網面，遮瑕度就已經完美。基本上真係唔需要用好多產品就完成底妝，感覺可以用好耐。
佢唔會凸顯乾紋，而且超級保濕。
喺我塊面呈現嘅水光感比較似玻璃光澤妝效，呢個正正就係我想要嘅效果。就算做完成12個鐘嘅更，幾乎都唔見乜嘢出油，原本嘅水光妝效仲keep到。
我高度推薦呢個氣墊畀同我一樣嘅乾性肌朋友。如果你受泛紅困擾，建議揀 #1.5 色號，佢可以好靚咁中和泛紅。

reviews.text: The packaging alone is cute, but the product inside is to die for! Most foundations end up looking cakey or separate erate on my pores fairly quickly, but with this I’ve noticed my skin only looking better and more glowy throughout the day. Easy to remove, easy to apply! The only downside is it a bit yellow for my skin tone, but next time I’ll get the more neutral shade :)
reviews.zh: 淨係包裝已經好得意，但入面嘅產品更加不得了！大部份粉底喺我塊面都好快就變厚重或者係毛孔到分離，但用咗呢個之後，我發現塊面成日都望落愈嚟愈好、愈嚟愈有光澤。容易卸、容易上！唯一嘅缺點係對我嘅膚色嚟講有少少黃，但下次我會揀返中性啲嘅色號 :)

reviews.text: It's not very radiant, more like satin-leaning dewy. #03 Healthy is a great neutral-yellow tone, and not toned up like other #23s. Coverage is a solid medium, while staying thin on the skin. Building for more coverage will make it heavy and crease more after time. Probably lasts up to ~7 hours. Retouches decently, but it won't fix spots that have settled into dry patches. I do not like fragrance in my base products but the scent is tiiny, not noticeable at all.
reviews.zh: 佢唔算好光澤，反而比較偏向緞面水光感。#03 Healthy 係一個好正嘅中性黃調，同其他 #23 唔同，唔會調亮。遮瑕度係穩穩陣陣嘅中度，喺皮膚上面保持輕薄。想疊加更多遮瑕嘅話會變得厚重，而且一段時間後會更加卡粉。應該可以撐到大概7個鐘。補妝效果唔錯，但對於已經沉入乾紋嘅位置就救唔返。我本身唔鍾意底妝產品有香味，但呢個嘅氣味好細好細，聞唔到。

reviews.text:
This cushion is very easy to apply on the face as it is dewy and will not pill or get cakey. The coverage is great for the little amount I used today. My face looks glowy and natural even after three hours of wearing. Usually I have to blot oil by the 3 hr mark but my skin doesn’t feel greasy or stuffy. 

Other products I used are the Amuse Jelly Fit Tint in Boksoonga Jelly, Rare Beauty Blush in Happy, and the Benefit 24 Hr Brow Setter, and Ilia Mascara

I applied at 7:30 AM and it is now 10:30 AM (the time I took the picture attached)
reviews.zh:
呢個氣墊因為係水光質感，所以好容易上面，唔會起擦膠碎或者厚重。對於我今日用嘅少量嚟講，遮瑕度已經好好。戴咗三個鐘之後塊面望落依然有光感好自然。通常我三個鐘就要吸油，但我塊面又唔覺得油膩或者焗促。

我同時用咗嘅其他產品有 Amuse Jelly Fit Tint 嘅 Boksoonga Jelly 色號、Rare Beauty Blush 嘅 Happy 色號、Benefit 24 Hr Brow Setter，同埋 Ilia 睫毛膏。

我係早上7:30上妝，而家係10:30（就係我影呢張相嘅時間）

reviews.text: it gives more coverage than dew jelly cushion. I didn't like this at the beginning. pigments wasn't absorbed well. felt like sliding on my skin. however i changed my skin care and let cushion set on my skin a little bit of time. it stays well and last longer, better than first time. I still preper dew jelly version like a light sheer glow texture, tho. It just different type of cushion. plus package design is so cute transparent pink!!! and petite cusion extra. i choose 02 healthy shade. it looks a bit yellowish tone on my redish skin tone but blended well.
reviews.zh: 佢嘅遮瑕度比 dew jelly cushion 強。一開始我唔鍾意呢個，顯色度吸收得唔好，感覺喺塊面到滑嚟滑去。不過我換咗護膚品，等個氣墊喺皮膚上面settle 多少少時間之後，佢貼服咗好多，持久度亦都長過第一次用。之不過我仲係比較鍾意 dew jelly 嗰個版本，鍾意佢嗰種輕透光澤嘅質感。佢哋只係唔同類型嘅氣墊姐。仲有就係包裝設計好靚呀，透明粉紅色!!!而且附送嘅細碼氣墊都好細緻。我揀咗02 healthy 色號，喺我偏紅嘅膚色上面望落有少少黃調，但都好易推開。

reviews.text:
This is my current daily cushion. 
First of all, the cushion is really big, but I love the packaging. It comes with a smaller cushion as well, perfect for travelling. 
I must say the formula it better for oily or combination skin. When my skin is dry the foundation clings to it and keeps peeling. 
However, on the day my skin is OK and not too dry, the foundation looks perfect.
It has a light to medium coverage, with a slight healthy glow. 
The best point about this cushion is that it is very long lasting. From the moment I get ready in the morning, until I finish work and take off my makeup (about 14-15h) the cushion still looks perfect on my skin
reviews.zh:
呢個係我而家日日用嘅氣墊。
首先，個氣墊真係好大，但我好鍾意個包裝。佢附送咗一個細啲嘅氣墊，方便去旅行用。
必須要講，呢個配方比較啱油性或者混合性肌。當我皮膚乾燥嘅時候，粉底會黐住乾位然後一直甩皮。
不過，當我皮膚狀態正常唔算太乾嗰日，個粉底望落就完美。
遮瑕度係中低度，帶少少健康光澤。
呢個氣墊最大嘅優點係非常持久。 由我朝早化完妝出門，到收工卸妝（大約14-15個鐘），個氣墊喺我塊面上面依然keep得好完美。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
